# Stone fixtures: sources and licenses

Openly licensed headstone photos from Wikimedia Commons, used only as test inputs for the Stamp Kit. Each local file is a downscaled copy of the original (same aspect ratio). Checked against the Commons API on 2026-10-20.

| Local file | Commons original | Author | License |
|---|---|---|---|
| `WashingtonIrvingGrave.jpg` (450×600) and `WashingtonIrvingGrave.gray.png` (grayscale derivative) | [File:WashingtonIrvingGrave.jpg](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:WashingtonIrvingGrave.jpg) | Chris Kirkman (ckirkman) from Sunrise, Florida, United States | [CC BY 2.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/2.0) |
| `AlfredIversonJrGrave.jpg` (800×1069) | [File:Alfrediversonjr.jpg](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Alfrediversonjr.jpg) (1712×2288) | Jamie Aaron | Public domain |
| `SamuelSpencerGrave.jpg` (1280×960) | [File:Samuel-Spencer-grave.JPG](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Samuel-Spencer-grave.JPG) (1632×1224) | Commons user Jolomo (uploader; no author field on the file page) | [CC BY-SA 3.0](http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/) |

Changes: resized to the dimensions shown; the `.gray.png` is a grayscale conversion. The derivatives keep their original licenses.
